svg.title: Dijkstra with a heap on tiny.map from 3 to 8, one frame per junction finished
svg.text: the best way in so far

g.title: Finish 3 at 0 m (the start). Pushed: 4 at 200, 2 at 300, 0 at 430, 1 at 600, 9 at 370.
Finish 4 at 200 m (from 3). Pushed: 5 at 400, 10 at 520.
Finish 2 at 300 m (from 3). Nothing new: its roads lead to junctions finished, or no nearer than they were.
Finish 9 at 370 m (from 3). Nothing new: its roads lead to junctions finished, or no nearer than they were.
Finish 0 at 430 m (from 3). Nothing new: its roads lead to junctions finished, or no nearer than they were.
Finish 7 at 800 m (from 6). Pushed: 8 at 1000. 8 was at 1200: now 1000, pushed again; the entry at 1200 is out of date and stays.
Finish 11 at 920 m (from 10). Nothing new: its roads lead to junctions finished, or no nearer than they were.
Finish 8 at 1000 m (from 7). It is TO: the route along the main street is 1000 metres. An old entry is left in the heap.
